scope: Finite source-bound topology diagnosis, not a new routed candidate or a physical qualification
previous_goal_turn: Progress: exact stocked cut-tape sourcing and a corrected interpretation of the manufacturer land drawing changed the part shortlist.
this_goal_turn: Progress: eight deliberately selected short-bridge placements and two in-memory counterfactual route studies failed to establish a complete full-width path; the evidence rules out treating a local C16 move alone as the demonstrated solution.

preserved_requirements.note: The enlarged land width is a geometry trial, not a qualified paste/joint pattern. No source current, board rule or bus outline was changed.

findings: Three vertical crossings near the input header still have foreign-pad or existing feed/via land conflicts. Their upstream full-width feeds encounter retained 3V3 copper.
One lower PCB link was found, but its proposed land is not clear; this is not a viable assembled path.
The horizontal crossing has one clear land, but the other overlaps PR1 routes and both full feeds remain unestablished.

front.findings: The short bridge can reach across the immediate 5V landing from existing 12V source copper in three positions, but its far foot overlaps the capacitor and associated supply/I2C routing. No complete unchanged-board path was found.

counterfactuals.meaning: Even after temporarily removing the immediate landing conflicts, neither the bounded direct search nor the manually specified right-side chain established a complete path. Relocating C16 alone is not demonstrated to solve it.
counterfactuals.limits: Not an exhaustive path impossibility proof. Removed supply/control tracks and capacitor were never reconstructed or accepted; no counterfactual is a valid board. One initial worker failed with a SWIG object-lifetime error before producing a report; retaining native wrappers in the corrected process allowed the diagnostic to complete.

verification.pictures_show: Existing source copper only; no installed bridge or claimed before/after compaction
verification.why_no_DRC_rerun: No candidate board was constructed and source hashes are unchanged; old zero-error/open evidence is not attributed to these proposed bridges.
